A page of Character voiceover showreels

My character voiceovers are heard on TV, Radio, Apps, Games & Virals worldwide daily.
“I hear voices in my head” that's me on a daily basis. So if you have a script and project, let me unleash them!

The UK's Most Versatile Character Voiceover Artist

Across TV, radio, games, apps and animation, my character voices pop up everywhere. From heroic narrators to unhinged goblins, and from blockbuster game villains to silly cartoon sidekicks — I lend my voice to worlds big and small. If you’ve got a script bursting with personality, I can bring it to life.

Character Voice Showreel – Guy Harris

I've created iconic character voices for Boom Beach, Minecraft, Clash of Clans, Thomas & Friends, The Joker, and even singing pirates. If it’s wild, wacky or wonderfully weird — I’m your guy.

Crazy Voice Guy | Unique Voices for Unique Characters

Hi there — I’m the Crazy Voice Guy. Whether you need a gangsta raccoon, a hopelessly romantic robot, a grumpy wizard, a lovable dog, or a full-on cartoon lunatic, I’m always up for creating something new. Character work is where I get to play, experiment and throw everything at the wall until the perfect voice appears.

Want to hear some more? This showreel features gaming voices, silly accents, singing characters and some truly daft creations. If you need a voice with personality (or several personalities), let’s chat.

For more examples, check out:
• Super Hero Voice
• Seabrooks “In For a Penny”
• Ghost Face Voice
• Pantomime Dame Voice

Let’s Work Together

Got a script ready? Or maybe you’ve just got a rough idea and need help shaping it? No problem. I can direct your session live via Cleanfeed, Zoom or Teams, helping you fine-tune pacing, personality and performance.

Whether it’s a big booming announcer, a retro Pathe News narrator, a Craig Cash-style Gogglebox character, or a Star Wars creature voice, I’m ready to help bring your character to life.

If you’ve got a YouTube clip or reference voice you want me to start from, even better. Ready to turn your character into something unforgettable? Get in touch today.
